Container.Name: subgen
Container.Overview: Subgen creates subtitles for personal media and forwards transcription work to an OpenAI-compatible audio endpoint. It can also be used as a Whisper Provider in Bazarr.
Container.Changes: Removed local Whisper, GPU, model-cache, and self-update settings. Added OpenAI-compatible audio endpoint settings.

Config.Name: Port: Webhook Port
Config.Description: FastAPI port for webhooks and Bazarr requests.

Config.Name: Path: /tv
Config.Description: Optional TV media path. Mount paths exactly as your media server sees them when using webhooks or Bazarr Pass Video Name.

Config.Name: Path: /movies
Config.Description: Optional movie media path. Mount paths exactly as your media server sees them when using webhooks or Bazarr Pass Video Name.

Config.Name: Variable: OPENAI_BASE_URL
Config.Description: Base URL for the OpenAI-compatible API.

Config.Name: Variable: OPENAI_API_KEY
Config.Description: Bearer token for the OpenAI-compatible API. Leave empty only if your endpoint does not require auth.

Config.Name: Variable: OPENAI_TRANSCRIPTION_MODEL
Config.Description: Model sent to /audio/transcriptions.

Config.Name: Variable: OPENAI_TRANSLATION_MODEL
Config.Description: Model sent to /audio/translations.

Config.Name: Variable: OPENAI_AUDIO_FORMAT
Config.Description: Audio format Subgen creates before upload. WAV is the safest default for whisper.cpp-compatible servers.

Config.Name: Variable: OPENAI_AUDIO_BITRATE
Config.Description: Bitrate for compressed upload formats.

Config.Name: Variable: MIN_REMOTE_AUDIO_SECONDS
Config.Description: Reject extracted WAV payloads shorter than this before sending them to the endpoint.

Config.Name: Variable: AUDIO_DEBUG
Config.Description: Log audio stream discovery, selected track, ffmpeg command/stderr, payload byte size, hash, and WAV duration.

Config.Name: Variable: AUDIO_DEBUG_SAVE
Config.Description: Save the exact upload payload for inspection.

Config.Name: Variable: AUDIO_DEBUG_DIR
Config.Description: Directory used when AUDIO_DEBUG_SAVE=True.

Config.Name: Variable: OPENAI_API_TIMEOUT
Config.Description: Audio API timeout and /asr wait timeout in seconds.

Config.Name: Variable: WEBHOOK_PORT
Config.Description: FastAPI listening port inside the container.

Config.Name: Variable: CONCURRENT_TRANSCRIPTIONS
Config.Description: Number of worker threads sending requests to the endpoint.

Config.Name: Variable: PROCESS_ADDED_MEDIA
Config.Description: Generate subtitles for added-media webhook events.

Config.Name: Variable: PROCESS_MEDIA_ON_PLAY
Config.Description: Generate subtitles for playback-start webhook events.

Config.Name: Variable: TRANSCRIBE_FOLDERS
Config.Description: Pipe-separated list of paths to scan, for example /tv|/movies.

Config.Name: Variable: TRANSCRIBE_OR_TRANSLATE
Config.Description: Use transcribe or translate.

Config.Name: Variable: DEBUG
Config.Description: Enable verbose logs.

Config.Name: Variable: SUBTITLE_LANGUAGE_NAME
Config.Description: Override the language part of generated subtitle filenames.

Config.Name: Variable: SKIP_IF_INTERNAL_SUBTITLES_LANGUAGE
Config.Description: Skip when the file has an embedded subtitle in this language.

Config.Name: Variable: PREFERRED_AUDIO_LANGUAGES
Config.Description: Pipe-separated audio languages to prefer for multi-track media.

Config.Name: Variable: FORCE_DETECTED_LANGUAGE_TO
Config.Description: Force a two-letter source language code.

Config.Name: Variable: SHOULD_DETECT_AUDIO_LANGUAGE
Config.Description: Use the transcription endpoint to detect language when media metadata is unknown.

Config.Name: Variable: APPEND
Config.Description: Append a short Subgen watermark to generated SRT files.

Config.Name: Variable: LRC_FOR_AUDIO_FILES
Config.Description: Generate LRC instead of SRT for pure audio files.

Config.Name: Variable: PLEX_SERVER
Config.Description: Plex server URL for webhooks and metadata refresh.

Config.Name: Variable: PLEX_TOKEN
Config.Description: Plex token.

Config.Name: Variable: JELLYFIN_SERVER
Config.Description: Jellyfin server URL for webhooks and metadata refresh.

Config.Name: Variable: JELLYFIN_TOKEN
Config.Description: Jellyfin API token.
